notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi, offroad enjoyers!

[b]Offroad Mechanic Simulator has finally arrived! [/b]You can now start your career as a specialist in repairing and customizing the best offroad cars in the world. Be ready to get your hands dirty - there is plenty of grease, mud, and sand on your way. Especially when you get your newly modified cars for an exciting test drive!

Remember that there is a launch celebration discount, which means that [b]you can enjoy 15% off the base price of 19.99 USD - for a limited time![/b] Or check out our bundles to get one more game in a discounted package.

[h2]Offroad Mechanic Simulator is available now![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/adb197c9b86683efde2be89826b0b70f144eaece.png[/img]

In Offroad Mechanic Simulator, you take the job that all car enthusiasts dream about. Your mission is to transform off-road vehicles into powerful beasts capable of conquering the toughest challenges. By equipping the vehicles with top-quality parts, you can significantly enhance their performance. You will also have to personally ensure that the vehicles meet the expectations of your customers. However, this will not be an easy task, as each project must be accomplished within a fixed budget.

Push the boundaries of safety as you boldly venture into treacherous terrains, fearlessly climbing rocky cliffs, and bravely crossing muddy rivers. Enjoy the breathtaking views of the scenic landscapes. Just remember to thoroughly clean the vehicle before returning it to the customer!

[b]Offroad Mechanic Simulator – key features:[/b]

🚙 [b]What a monster! [/b]– repair, modify, and upgrade powerful machines that you will then personally take on demanding tests.
🚙 [b]Become a master[/b] – career mode with story missions will challenge you to demonstrate your expertise and skills like no one else.
🚙 [b]The kingdom of wrenches and grease[/b] – in your workshop, you will have everything a mechanic could dream of. The availability of professional equipment makes the work even more enjoyable.
🚙 [b]Grit in your teeth [/b]– a realistic driving model that embraces the true challenges of off-road style driving. The whole experience is accompanied by beautiful forest and desert landscapes, where there are plenty of obstacles to overcome.

[hr][/hr]
Remember that you can ask us anything on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/q3AEaFyXX2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2fc705973d339be579fc7a40a2b877dc85c1fdfb.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator will debut on Steam on July 24th
notes.notes:
Hi, fans of offroad!

If you can nearly hear the engines roar, that means Offroad Mechanic Simulator is closing by! We hope you had a lot of fun with the prologue, and learned the ropes because the full version of the game is just around the corner. So prepare to experience the complete range of what the game has to offer: unique cars, all the tools you can ask for, a wide selection of customization choices, and exciting challenges where you drive the offroad beasts you've created!

[h2]Offroad Mechanic Simulator will debut on Steam on July 24th! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

Offroad Mechanic Simulator will be available for 19.99 USD and of course, we will prepare some attractive bundles for you to enjoy!

We have also prepared a new trailer for your viewing pleasure:

[previewyoutube=wk_TPY41mxk;full][/previewyoutube]

In Offroad Mechanic Simulator you will find:

[list]
[*] Multiple unique cars to work on and drive
[*] Career mode with story missions
[*] Various randomized assignments and jobs to complete
[*] Fully-equipped garage with all the tools a professional mechanic needs
[*] A wide selection of parts to install that allow your cars to achieve remarkable feats
[*] A wide selection of paint jobs and decals to personalize the cars
[*] Realistic driving model true to the offroad-style challenges
[*] Beautiful Forest and Desert environments are plentiful with obstacles to conquer
[*] Different tracks where you can test if your vehicles are ready for an offroad challenge
[*] Unlimited fun with creating vehicles that can face anything!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 for Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job
notes.notes:
Hi, offroaders,

Over the weekend we deployed another patch for the prologue, which most of you should have already automatically downloaded. Below you will find the patch notes. We have added more tooltips for better clarity of some menus and introduced other minor quality-of-life improvements.

[h2]Patch notes for update 1.03[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375553/52f5fb595fe3f5c43edbed06acb6d90b9456a390.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] added a tooltip showing the names of additional parts
[*] TAB key icon is shown also on the open task list, so players can always see how to collapse the list
[*] swapped the question mark to Press F1 as an icon next to the hint panel
[*] enlarged the input icons on the driving UI and interaction hints
[*] added a percentage value to part statistics tooltip
[*] removed the Q/E prompt if the tutorial has only one page
[*] moving the cursor to yellow/red (blocked) parts showing interaction hints (focus, tutorial)
[*] added a pop-up when the player is trying to change the drive type when driving
[*] added the next/previous drive in the button description of the driving UI
[*] added the option to swap the hook of the winch to belt/lift while holding it
[*] added a pop-up when a player pulls out the hook of the winch without the belt attached to any tree
[*] fixes to the Chinese language
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
Remember that you can ask us anything on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/q3AEaFyXX2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2fc705973d339be579fc7a40a2b877dc85c1fdfb.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Patch 1.02 for Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job
notes.notes:
Hi, offroaders,

This week we have brought you more quality-of-life changes with the 1.02 patch. We have tinkered with some visual elements of the game to make them more clear. We also tweaked some minor, but noticeable problems in the gear-switching system. Your game should have already updated itself during the few last days.

Enjoy!

[h2]Update 1.02 Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375553/12b27e23b0ee82e4f6795e60b4d6070894c69353.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] adjusted the scaling of the email inbox/shop UI for 16:10 resolutions
[*] fixed the unchanging dropdown icon when using filters
[*] fixed the selection issue, which made the selection of the category in the shop not disappear properly (when pressing ESC with a category selected)
[*] fixed the gear reduction if the engine speed is too low
[*] adjusted the gear switching when the car was on D gear (Drive) and stuck in place
[*] removed the blocker occurring when the  player entered the modification mode from far away by interacting with a part
[*] improved visibility of arrows pointing out tutorial tasks
[*] improvements to localization (all languages)
[/list]

notes.title: 50 GB download problem solved for the prologue
notes.notes:

If you find any further issues with the download, please inform us in the dedicated thread here on Steam or via Discord: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2260130/discussions/0/6142387869102560217/

notes.title: Patch 1.01 for Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job
notes.notes:
Hi, offroaders,

Hope you're having a lot of fun with the prologue so far. We'd want to inform you that the first patch for the game is available to download now, with fixes for some minor technical issues.

[h2]Update 1.01 Patch Notes [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375553/8b5cfdfef2da84e0c452e54d6f81e32397439d02.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed the wrong names of the wheel items in the inventory
[*] Updated completion conditions for the task of finding Mishubi Palermo - driving through the last checkpoint is not mandatory now
[*] Fixed the flickering outline of the tire changer arm
[*] Fixed the collision detection in the tire changer
[*] Fixed the vanishing pallets in the garage
[*] Fixed the UI and tutorial screens scaling for 16:10 resolution
[*] Fixes for the Chinese language 
[*] Fixes for the map selection screen
[/list]

We would also like to inform about a known issue occuring during the download of the prologue.

Sometimes when you try to download the prologue, Steam may inform you that 50 GB of free space is needed on your drive and won't proceed with the installation if you have less space available.

This is a Steam issue, as the game only requires around 8 GB of free space after installation. We are working on resolving it as quickly as possible. We will update you when it's resolved.

[hr][/hr]

[url=https://discord.gg/q3AEaFyXX2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2fc705973d339be579fc7a40a2b877dc85c1fdfb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job is live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi, offroaders!

The time has come! Our free prologue is available now! You can test a big chunk of core Offroad Mechanic Simulator gameplay and features - and have fun with the prologue as a standalone experience. We hope you will enjoy your time in the garage, as well as driving through the forest landscape - through dirt, mud, and harsh terrain!

[b][h2]Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job is live on Steam![/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375553/e014e81fcec2488e8f550af17f9083dabf52dcac.jpg[/img]

In the prologue, you will have a chance to experience fully polished gameplay reflecting the features of the full version - with physics, car models, handling, UI, and many other elements vastly improved over the older demo. You'll also have all of the core mechanics and functions of the game available to test and enjoy. Of course, that also means you will be able to take three of the offroad beasts' roster for a ride through the scenic Forest map.

Key features of the prologue:

[list]
[*] Improved physics, car models, and handling
[*] Entirely new UI
[*] Three new cars to dismantle and re-assemble
[*] Repair, Washing, Tuning, and Adjustment commissions
[*] A new Forest map to conquer
[*] New garage rooms, parts, and options
[*] New perks and skills
[*] Possibility of achieving up to level 4 of experience
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[url=https://discord.gg/q3AEaFyXX2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2fc705973d339be579fc7a40a2b877dc85c1fdfb.png[/img][/url]
